leadText:
Akiko Kimura (Japanese: 木村亜希子 Kimura Akiko) is a Japanese voice actress for . She was born on June 28, 1971 in , .

Apart from her voicing career, she is also a certified kindergarten and elementary school teacher, as well as a famous singer.
plainText:
Akiko Kimura (Japanese: 木村亜希子 Kimura Akiko) is a Japanese voice actress for . She was born on June 28, 1971 in , .

Apart from her voicing career, she is also a certified kindergarten and elementary school teacher, as well as a famous singer.

==Pokémon roles==
Kimura mostly voiced characters of the day. Her most famous role was Anabel during .
